post.description: Uploads an evidence file, computes its SHA-256 fingerprint, stores it in the local evidence store and appends a hash-chained audit record. Optional `metadata` (JSON string) keys used by the analysis: `recorded_at` (ISO time of the first video frame / document date) and `location_id` (camera zone, host location).

post.summary: Start analysing all evidence of a case
post.description: Queues a background run that processes every evidence item of the case into canonical events and correlates them (timeline, contradictions, evidence graph, suspect ranking). Poll `GET /api/analysis/{run_id}` until `status` is `completed` or `failed`. Returns 409 if a run is already active for the case. Video evidence is CPU-heavy; set `include_video=false` for a fast run.

post.description: Runs TimeSformer crime detection on a video file located on disk.
Quick-look analysis of an uploaded video (not stored as evidence). To make video part of a case, upload it via POST /api/evidence with source_type=cctv_video and run POST /api/analysis/start.
Downloads Nikeytas/timesformer-best-crime-detector weights from Hugging Face.
